notes.title: Update Notes for April 17
notes.content:
- Added the possibilty to see leaderboards for dark worlds
- Fixed an issue where bananas could clip into walls
- Fixed an issue where the game could softlock if you pressed pause and restarted the level at a certain time frame after dying

notes.title: Update Notes for April 16
notes.content:

- Made some game mechanics clearer through NPCs

notes.title: Update Notes For April 15
notes.content:

notes.title: Update Notes for April 14
notes.content:
